text:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service=redwood-inference-api-prod severity=critical — trigger_id=PD-98321 — routing_key=ops-oncall
emily: seeing pages in ops for inference 503s. this looks wrong — the model-serving team should own this service
raj: got the same page. PD payload shows tag `team:ops` in the webhook. did we change service tags in the last deploy?
emily: we rolled a small mapping change yesterday to PD mappings via the infra deploy PR (rollout 2026-03-01). suspicious.
incident-bot: Created incident INC-2026-103 in #incidents (priority=P1) — responders: ops-oncall, model-serving-oncall. Link: https://redundant.pagerduty/INC-2026-103
sara: @mike can you check oncall and ack? paging is noisy.
mike: I'm oncall and acking. logging into PD console now. :eyes:
mike: quick peek: the service binding for redwood-inference-api-prod points to PD service id that routes to `ops-oncall`. Should be `model-serving-prod`.
emily: yep that matches. PD mapping got overwritten by a config merge. we need a quick reroute and to stop duplicates.
raj: can we suppress or mute the ops escalation while we reroute?
mike: applying a temporary suppression on PD and adding a reroute rule.

mike: command I'm running in PD CLI:
```
pd service edit --id PD-SVC-778 --name "redwood-inference-api-prod" --escalation-policy model-serving-policy
pd maintenance-window create --service PD-SVC-778 --duration 10m --description "temporary suppress to avoid duplicate pages"
```

pagerbot: :white_check_mark: PD maintenance window created for redwood-inference-api-prod (10m)
raj: I see the suppression. new pages should stop firing to ops.
emily: please also update the mapping in our infra-config repo so next deploy doesn't flip it again.
mike: done. updated mapping in PD console and pushed hotfix to repo branch infra/pd-fix-1725. will open PR.

sara: customer impact? any users affected aside from noisy pages?
emily: monitoring shows increased 5xx rate between 2026-03-01T02:10Z and 02:34Z for the inference API. Two enterprise customers reported transient failures and one internal alerting workflow retried.
raj: collection: scope logs for that window, correlate to nodes with recent kernel upgrade.
mike: confirmed: root cause likely unrelated to PD — a rolling kernel update increased ephemeral connection errors. paging misrouting amplified noise to wrong oncall.
emily: tl;dr: kernel update => 5xx spike; PD mapping error => pages went to ops rather than model-serving; duplicate pages due to no suppression rule for this mapping.
sara: action items:
- emily: open postmortem (I/O + routing mixup)
- mike: merge hotfix to infra and add CI test for PD mapping
- raj: add alert rule to only page primary-svc-owner tag and fallback to routing-policy after 2 minutes
- incident-bot: tag incident with these action items

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-103 marked RESOLVED by mike — duration 00:25: (start 1725555555 end 1725555900)
mike: closing thread. will file support PR to notify affected customers and CS.
emily: thanks all. follow-up: add a PD mapping smoke test in deploy pipeline and we should be good. :thumbsup:
